name: Manhattan Village
summary: Chain known for unique gadgets, gifts & lifestyle items, such as electronics & travel accessories.
description: Manhattan Village is an upscale open-air shopping destination in the heart of Manhattan Beach, featuring a sophisticated mix of premier retailers, dining, and entertainment options. The center offers a relaxed, coastal-inspired shopping experience with wide pedestrian walkways and modern architecture that reflects the affluent beach community it serves.
demographics: Manhattan Village attracts an affluent, educated demographic primarily consisting of families and professionals aged 30-55 with household incomes exceeding $150,000, reflecting the wealthy beach communities of Manhattan Beach, Hermosa Beach, and El Segundo. The trade area is characterized by high home values, dual-income households, and consumers with strong purchasing power who prioritize quality and lifestyle brands. Shoppers at this center typically exhibit preferences for premium brands, sustainable products, and experiential retail combined with upscale dining options that complement the sophisticated South Bay coastal lifestyle.
